name: Manila Hold Em Poker
summary: Stripped-deck Hold'em variant where players combine two hole cards with three of five community cards; flush beats full house.
rules_text: Play with 32 cards: 7 through Ace in each suit, four suits stripped. Deal two private hole cards face down to each player. Deal one community card face up in center. Conduct a betting round. Then for four more times, deal one additional community card face up and conduct a betting round, for five community cards and five betting rounds total. At showdown each remaining player must make the best five-card poker hand using exactly their two hole cards and exactly three of the community cards. Hand rankings are standard except a flush beats a full house and A-7-8-9-10 is not a straight; Ace cannot be low.
rating_reason: Poker variant: hidden hands, betting, bluffing, fits engine.
